key_insight: GMMag generates crystal structures with site-resolved magnetic moments and retargets generation toward chemical and magnetic goals using Gaussian-mixture sampling without retraining.
engineering_relevance: The workflow supports magnetic-material candidate discovery while estimating how duplicate chemical formulas limit distinct-candidate yield under a finite sampling budget.
method: Combine a graph-neural-network encoder with a transformer decoder in a conditional variational autoencoder.
Use Gaussian-mixture sampling to target selected chemical and magnetic properties.
Model repeated-formula generation to predict accumulation of qualifying formulas absent from the reference dataset.
evidence_signal: The study compares architecture, magnetic-moment representations and sampling choices, tests yield prediction in two separate ten-million-draw runs, and identifies Nd-containing candidates with negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.
watch_item: Absence from the reference dataset does not establish global novelty, and estimated magnetic performance requires further validation.
paper_title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
